title: Chapter 6 Mini-Capstone: The Resilient Payment Gateway, Watcher & Idempotent Store (payment_system.erl)
solutionExplanation: Implements a complete resilient payment gateway with a durable Watcher coordinator, idempotent transaction store, and monitored worker crash recovery.

mentalModelCheck.question: In the resilient payment gateway architecture, why does the Watcher store completed transactions rather than the Payment Worker?

options.label: The worker is a disposable process that may crash on corrupted payloads; keeping durable financial history in the Watcher ensures all settled transactions survive worker crashes.
options.explanation: Correct! Isolating volatile worker tasks from durable state is the core principle of Erlang fault tolerance. Workers are disposable; the Watcher guarantees state continuity.

options.label: Erlang worker processes cannot write to maps.
options.explanation: Any process can write to maps.

options.label: The Watcher runs directly in the Linux kernel.
options.explanation: Both Watcher and Worker are standard user-space BEAM processes.
